    <article data-role="Administrator" data-product="Webex Contact Center" data-operatingsystem="Web Browser" role="article">
  
  
  <div><article class="topic" id="generic-template_a57806a8-d941-4ccd-b0a4-0fb52ce2c54e"><div class="body taskbody" id="">
      <p class="p">Once you've created and configured your AI agents in the Webex AI Agent Studio platform, the next step is to integrate them with the voice and digital channels. This
      integration allows the AI agents to handle both voice-based and digital conversations with
      your customers, providing a seamless and interactive user experience.</p>
      <div class="olh_note"><div class="note__content"><div role="note" class="olh_note"><div class="note-container"><span class="svg-container"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" fill="none"       <p class="p">Access to the autonomous AI agent for the voice calls is currently limited to specific
        customers. For more information, please reach out to Cisco support.</p>
    </div></div></div></div>
    </div></article></div>
  <p class="topictitle1" id=""></p><div class="tabs-container"><ul class="nav nav-tabs"><li class="active"><a href="#concept-template_923d7918-2e98-451d-8f4b-d3aaf4c4896b" data-toggle="tab" class="btn btn-primary">Voice</a></li><li><a href="#generic-template_76f2c5c1-4eb2-4f46-a3d6-04c0f0c75ba4" data-toggle="tab" class="btn btn-primary">Digital</a></li></ul><div class="tab-content"><div id="concept-template_923d7918-2e98-451d-8f4b-d3aaf4c4896b" class="tab-pane fade in active"><div><article class="topic concept" id="concept-template_923d7918-2e98-451d-8f4b-d3aaf4c4896b"><div class="body conbody" id="">
        <p class="p">The following sections detail the configuration flow for integrating AI agents with the voice
      channel, enabling them to manage voice-based customer interactions effectively.  </p>
        <section class="section" id="section_lny_q4k_b2c">
      <h2 class="title sectiontitle">Prerequisites</h2>
      <p class="p">
        </p><ol class=""><li class="li">Create and configure the AI agents. For more information, see  <a title="" href="https://help.webex.com/en-us/article/ncs9r37/Webex-AI-Agent-Studio-Administration-guide#task-template_72a02c77-a182-4301-b588-235a042809a2" data-scope="external">Set up scripted AI agent</a> and  <a title="" href="https://help.webex.com/en-us/article/ncs9r37/Webex-AI-Agent-Studio-Administration-guide#task-template_cd5ff649-b94c-4546-82e9-6dac68310ab9" data-scope="external">Set up autonomous AI agent</a> sections in the Webex
            AI Agent Studio Administration guide.</li><li class="li">Set up the voice channel: <ol class=""><li class="li">Create an entry point for the voice channel.</li><li class="li">Assign the routing flow to the entry point. For more information, see the article
                   <a title="" href="https://help.webex.com/en-us/article/ewuay1/Set-up-a-channel" data-scope="external">Set up a channel</a>.</li></ol></li><li class="li">Set up a flow. For more information, see the  <a title="" href="https://help.webex.com/en-us/article/nhovcy4/Flow-Designer#Cisco_Generic_Topic.dita_d32d6ead-60c0-4ae7-8750-9a1ba7663e56" data-scope="external">Create and Manage Flows</a> section in the Flow
            Designer article.</li></ol>
      <p></p>
    </section>
        <section class="section" id="section_cnj_s4k_b2c">
          <h2 class="title sectiontitle">Configure AI agents in flow</h2>
          <p class="p">The Virtual Agent
        V2 activity provides a real-time conversational experience for your contacts. You can add
        the Virtual Agent V2 activity to the call flow to handle speech-based AI-enabled
        conversations. When a caller speaks, the system matches the speech to the best intent in the
        AI agent. Further, it assists the caller as part of the Interactive Voice Response (IVR)
        experience.</p>
          <strong class="ph b">Outcomes</strong>
          <p class="p">The outcome of the conversation between the caller and
        virtual agent determines this output path.</p>
          <ul class="ul">
            <li class="li">
          <p class="p"><strong class="ph b">Handled</strong>—The outcome is invoked when the virtual agent execution is
            completed.</p>
        </li>
            <li class="li">
          <p class="p"><strong class="ph b">Escalated</strong>—The outcome is invoked when the call is required to be escalated to
            the human agent.</p>
        </li>
          </ul>
          <strong class="ph b">Error Handling</strong>
          <p class="p">Any error that occurs during the conversation between the virtual
        agent and the caller determines this output path.</p>
          <p class="p">
            <strong class="ph b">Errored</strong>—The flow takes this
        path in any error scenarios.</p>
          <ol class="">
            <li class="li">Drag and drop the <strong class="ph b">Virtual Agent V2</strong> activity from the <strong class="ph b">Activity Library</strong> to
          the main flow canvas. </li>
            <li class="li">In <strong class="ph b">General Settings</strong>, perform the following actions:<ol class=""><li class="li">In the <strong class="ph b">Activity Label</strong> field, enter a name for the activity.</li><li class="li">In the <strong class="ph b">Activity Description</strong> field, enter a description for the activity.</li></ol></li>
            <li class="li">In the <strong class="ph b">Conversational Experience</strong> settings,<ul class="ul"><li class="li">For scripted AI agents:<ol class=""><li class="li">Select <strong class="ph b">Webex AI Agent Scripted</strong> from the <strong class="ph b">Contact Center AI Config</strong>
                  drop-down list.</li><li class="li">Select one of the published scripted agents under the <strong class="ph b">Virtual Agent
                  </strong>drop-down list.</li></ol></li><li class="li">For autonomous AI agents:<ol class=""><li class="li">Select <strong class="ph b">Webex AI Agent Autonomous</strong> from the <strong class="ph b">Contact Center AI Config</strong>
                  drop-down list.</li><li class="li">Select one of the published autonomous agents under the <strong class="ph b">Virtual Agent
                  </strong>drop-down list.</li></ol></li></ul><div class="olh_note"><div class="note__content"><div role="note" class="olh_note"><div class="note-container"><span class="svg-container"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 22 22" height="22" width="22" aria-hidden="true"><path fill="#1170CF" d="M15.8125 2.75H6.1875C5.27615 2.75107             <p class="p">You need to set the global variables in the flow to configure the default input
              language and output voice for virtual agent.</p>
            
            <p class="p">If you want to override the default input language and output voice for the Webex AI
              Agent that are configured in AI Agent Studio, include Set Variable activities before
              the Virtual Agent V2 activity in the flow. For more information about how to add
              global variables in the flow, see  <a title="" href="https://help.webex.com/en-us/article/nhovcy4/Build-and-manage-flows-with-Flow-Designer#Cisco_Generic_Topic.dita_0a32bcfc-1bfc-4413-bf75-7e941b228a81" data-scope="external">Global Variables in Flow Designer</a>.</p>
            <p class="p">For custom input language, configure the Set Variable activity as follows: </p><ul class="ul"><li class="li">Set the variable to Global_Language.</li><li class="li">Set the variable value to the required language code (for example, fr-CA).</li></ul><p></p>
            <p class="p">For custom output voice, configure the Set Variable activity as follows:</p><ul class="ul"><li class="li">Set the variable to Global_VoiceName.</li><li class="li">Set the variable value to the required output voice name code (for example,
                    en-US-Jennifer).<div class="olh_note"><div class="note__content"><div role="note" class="olh_note"><div class="note-container"><span class="svg-container"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 22 22" height="22" width="22" aria-hidden="true"><path fill="#1170CF" d="M15.8125 2.75H6.1875C5.27615 2.75107 4.40243 3.11358 3.75801                     <p class="p"><strong class="ph b">Important</strong>: The voice you select must be supported by the engine your
                      AI Agent uses. Otherwise, calls will exit the error path of the VAV2
                      activity.</p>
                  </div></div></div></div></li></ul><p></p>
            <p class="p">For more information about the supported voices and languages, see  <a title="" href="https://help.webex.com/en-us/article/pdef2d/Supported-languages-and-voices-for-AI-agents" data-scope="external">Supported languages and voices for AI
              agents</a>.</p>
          </div></div></div></div></li>
            <li class="li">In the <strong class="ph b">State Event</strong> settings, enter the custom event name and the data in the
            <strong class="ph b">Event Name - Event Data</strong> columns. The State Event is a mechanism to trigger the
          event handler that is configured on the Webex AI agent. In the AI agent, you can configure
          how the event must be handled.<ul class="ul"><li class="li">
              <p class="p"><strong class="ph b">Event Name</strong>–(optional) Indicates the name of the event that is defined on the
                integrated third-party AI platform.</p>
            </li><li class="li">
              <p class="p"><strong class="ph b">Event Data</strong>–(optional) Indicates the JSON data that the system sends (as part
                of the defined event name) to the integrated third-party AI platform.</p>
            </li></ul><p class="p">You can specify the event name and the data in the form of a static value or
            expression. For expressions, use this syntax: <code class="ph codeph">{{ variable }}</code>. The
            following is an example of the state event that is configured to greet the caller with a
            custom welcome message.</p><p class="p"><strong class="ph b">Event Name</strong>:
              <code class="ph codeph">CustomWelcome</code></p><p class="p"><strong class="ph b">Event Data</strong>: <code class="ph codeph">{"Name":
              "John"}</code></p></li>
            <li class="li">In <span class="ph uicontrol">Advanced Settings</span>, check the <span class="ph uicontrol">Enable voice
            recording</span> check box to allow recording of conversations between the AI agent
          and the customer. When enabled, the recordings appears in the <strong class="ph b">Sessions</strong> page within
          AI Agent Studio application.<div class="olh_note"><div class="note__content"><div role="note" class="olh_note"><div class="note-container"><span class="svg-container"><svg             <p class="p">The service applies layered controls, including automated detection of patterns that
              may indicate PCI data in AI Agent recordings and limit its visibility in AI Agent
              Studio. Automated detection may not identify every instance of such patterns, as
              demonstrated in the following scenarios:</p><ul class="ul"><li class="li"><strong class="ph b">Unprompted disclosure by the caller</strong>: A caller may share payment card or
                  related information outside of the expected call flow, which may affect detection
                  reliability. </li><li class="li"><strong class="ph b">Speech-to-Text (STT) transcription limitations</strong>: If the STT model
                  transcribes payment card related details incompletely, inaccurately, or in an
                  unexpected format, detection may be less reliable.</li><li class="li"><strong class="ph b">Abrupt call termination</strong>: Calls may be disconnected before backend systems
                  can fully analyze the conversation and identify sensitive content, resulting in
                  missed or delayed detection.</li></ul><p></p>
          </div></div></div></div></li>
            <li class="li">Use the following <strong class="ph b">Activity Output Variables</strong> to handle various use cases:<ul class="ul"><li class="li"><strong class="ph b">VirtualAgentV2.TranscriptURL</strong>—Stores the URL that points to the transcript of
              the conversation between the AI agent and the caller. </li><li class="li">
              <p class="p"><strong class="ph b">VirtualAgentV2.MetaData</strong>—Stores the JSON data that the system receives from
                the agent as part of the fulfillment, handling custom event, or transfer action. You
                can use this data to build more business logic in the flow builder. </p>
              <p class="p">See the following examples populated in the MetaData variable for different
                scenarios:</p>
              <p class="p"><strong class="ph b">Handled Outcome</strong></p><pre class="codeblock"><code class="codeblock">{
	"actions": {
		"get_flight_info": [
			{
				"input": {
					"booking_id": "IE428656",
					"last_name": "Joyce"
                },
				"type": "fulfillment"
			}
		]

	}
}</code></pre><p></p>
              <p class="p"><strong class="ph b">Escalated Outcome</strong></p>
              <p class="p"><strong class="ph b">For custom transfer:</strong></p>
              <p class="p">The escalation metadata and the action information.</p>
              <ul class="ul"><li class="li">escalation_type → custom</li><li class="li">escalation_trigger → The name of the transfer action that triggered the
                  escalation</li><li class="li">actions - list of actions triggered during the invocation</li></ul>
              <pre class="codeblock"><code class="codeblock">{
    "escalation_type": "custom",
    "escalation_trigger": "booking_agent_transfer",
	"actions": {
		"booking_agent_transfer": [
			{
				"input": {
					"zipcode": "12345",
					"date_of_birth": "27-06-1973"
                },
				"type": "transfer"
			}
		]

	}
}</code></pre>
              <p class="p"><strong class="ph b">For System Transfer</strong></p>
              <p class="p">This is the default system transfer output example.</p><ul class="ul"><li class="li">escalation_type → system</li><li class="li">escalation_trigger → agent_transfer</li><li class="li">actions - list of actions triggered during the invocation</li></ul><p></p>
              <pre class="codeblock"><code class="codeblock">{
    "escalation_type": "system",
    "escalation_trigger": "agent_transfer",
	"actions": {
		"agent_transfer": [
			{
				"input": {
					"message": "I’ll connect you with a human representative now. Please hold on for a moment while I transfer you."
                },
				"type": "transfer"
			}
		]

	}
}</code></pre>
            </li><li class="li">
              <p class="p"><strong class="ph b">VirtualAgentV2.StateEventName</strong>—Stores the name of the custom event that the
                system receives from the Webex AI agent after the system triggers a custom state
                event.</p>
            </li></ul></li>
          </ol>
          <p class="p">See the following flow templates in the Flow Designer Guide for details on using AI
        agents on voice channels:</p><ul class="ul"><li class="li">
            <p class="p"> <a title="" href="https://help.webex.com/en-us/article/nhovcy4/Build-and-manage-flows-with-Flow-Designer#ai-agent-autonomous-package-tracking" data-scope="external">AI Agent Autonomous (Package Tracking)</a></p>
          </li><li class="li">
            <p class="p"> <a title="" href="https://help.webex.com/en-us/article/nhovcy4/Build-and-manage-flows-with-Flow-Designer#ai-agent-scripted-package-tracking" data-scope="external">AI Agent Scripted (Package Tracking)</a></p>
          </li><li class="li">
            <p class="p"> <a title="" href="https://help.webex.com/en-us/article/nhovcy4/Build-and-manage-flows-with-Flow-Designer#ai-agent-scripted-doctors-appointment-booking" data-scope="external">AI Agent Scripted (Doctor's Appointment
                Booking)</a></p>
          </li></ul><p></p>
        </section>
        <section class="section" id="section_j3r_hpk_b2c">
      <h2 class="title sectiontitle">Configure custom events</h2>
      <p class="p">In the voice channel, custom events allow the flow designer to orchestrate complex
        interactions with the AI agent. This is particularly useful when fulfilling intents requires
        actions such as retrieving data from external systems or making calls to third-party APIs.
        The flow designer implements the necessary logic for these fulfillment actions.</p><div class="olh_note"><div class="note__content"><div role="note" class="olh_note"><div class="note-container"><span class="svg-container"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 22 22" height="22" width="22" aria-hidden="true"><path fill="#1170CF" d="M15.8125           <p class="p">Currently, custom events are supported for scripted and autonomous AI agents through
            voice channel only.</p>
        </div></div></div></div> For more information, see the  <a title="" href="https://help.webex.com/en-us/article/n5uo60x" data-scope="external"><i>Configure custom events for AI agent</i></a> article.<p></p>
    </section>
      </div></article></div></div><div id="generic-template_76f2c5c1-4eb2-4f46-a3d6-04c0f0c75ba4" class="tab-pane fade"><div><article class="topic" id="generic-template_76f2c5c1-4eb2-4f46-a3d6-04c0f0c75ba4"><div class="body taskbody" id="">
        <p class="p">The following sections outline the configuration flow for integrating AI agents with digital
      channels and enabling them to handle digital interactions with the customers. </p>
        <section class="section" id="section_zfr_1jv_ycc">
      <h2 class="title sectiontitle">Prerequisites</h2>
      <ol class=""><li class="li">
          <p class="p">Create and configure the AI agents. For more information, see  <a title="" href="https://help.webex.com/en-us/article/ncs9r37/Webex-AI-Agent-Studio-Administration-guide#task-template_72a02c77-a182-4301-b588-235a042809a2" data-scope="external">Set up scripted AI agent</a> and  <a title="" href="https://help.webex.com/en-us/article/ncs9r37/Webex-AI-Agent-Studio-Administration-guide#task-template_cd5ff649-b94c-4546-82e9-6dac68310ab9" data-scope="external">Set up autonomous AI agent</a> sections in the Webex
            AI Agent Studio Administration guide.</p>
        </li><li class="li">
          <p class="p">Configure your digital channel. Webex Connect and Webex Contact Center integration
            currently support six channels, namely WhatsApp, SMS, Email, Facebook Messenger, Apple
            Messages for Business, and Live Chat. For more information to configure the channel
            assets for each of these channels, see  <a title="" href="https://help.webexconnect.io/docs/wxcc-channel-assset-configuration-wxcc" data-scope="external">Channel Asset Configuration</a>. </p>
        </li><li class="li">
          <p class="p">Create a flow on Webex Connect. For more information, see  <a title="" href="https://help.webexconnect.io/docs/create-a-new-flow" data-scope="external">Creating a Flow on Webex Connect</a>.</p>
        </li></ol>
    </section>
        <section class="section" id="section_ztx_mkv_ycc">
      <h2 class="title sectiontitle">Configure AI agents in flow</h2>
      <p class="p">You can use an <span class="ph uicontrol">AI Agent</span> node to answer specific queries from a corpus or knowledge base. You can also enable multiturn conversations. The AI agent can ask follow-up questions, understand context, and provide personalized responses.</p>
    </section>
        <p class="p">Simply drag and drop the <span class="ph uicontrol">AI Agent</span> node onto your visual flow builder to get started. This node helps you use scripted and autonomous AI agents configured within the Webex AI Agent Studio. </p>
        <section class="section" id="section_o1c_3cw_ycc">
      <h2 class="title sectiontitle">Configure input and output variables in AI agent node</h2>
      <p class="p">The AI Agent node contains two methods:</p>
      <ul class="ul"><li class="li">
          <p class="p">Process Message—Allows you to send user messages to the selected agent and get agent responses back.</p>
        </li><li class="li">
          <p class="p">Close session—Allows you to close a session in the AI agent. In certain scenarios, it may be necessary to close an existing AI agent session and initiate a new one. It can be achieved using a specific method within the AI Agent node. For example, if a session remains inactive for a specified period, the system closes the session automatically to optimize resources.</p>
        </li></ul>
      <ol class=""><li class="li">In the Process Message method, configure the following input variables:<ul class="ul"><li class="li"><span class="ph uicontrol">Agent type</span>—The type of agent used in the flow—whether
              scripted or autonomous.</li><li class="li"><span class="ph uicontrol">Agent</span>—The agent that processes the user message and gets a
                response.<div class="olh_note"><div class="note__content"><div role="note" class="olh_note"><div class="note-container"><span class="svg-container"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 22 22" height="22" width="22" aria-hidden="true"><path fill="#1170CF" d="M15.8125 2.75H6.1875C5.27615 2.75107 4.40243 3.11358 3.75801                 <p class="p">You can see the AI agents that you have access to in the Webex AI Agent Studio. For more information on managing users and agents in Webex AI Agent Studio, see  <a title="" href="https://help.webexconnect.io/docs/user-roles-and-hierarchy" data-scope="external">User roles and managing teammates</a>.</p>
              </div></div></div></div></li><li class="li"><span class="ph uicontrol">Message</span>—The variable name containing the incoming customer
              message sent to the chosen AI agent</li><li class="li"><span class="ph uicontrol">Language</span>—If the chosen AI agent is multilingual, you can
              choose the language of the incoming message in the <strong class="ph b">Language </strong>drop-down list. We
              populate the drop-down list based on languages in AI agent settings.<div class="olh_note"><div class="note__content"><div role="note" class="olh_note"><div class="note-container"><span                 <p class="p">We disable this drop-down list for agents with a single language.</p>
              </div></div></div></div></li><li class="li"><span class="ph uicontrol">Channel</span>—The name of the channel from which the system
              receives the customer's message.</li><li class="li"><span class="ph uicontrol">User identifier</span>—Provide the user's unique identifier for the
              chosen channel.</li><li class="li"><span class="ph uicontrol">Custom Parameters</span> (optional)—You can pass additional
              information about the customer to the Webex AI Agent Studio as a key value pair. We associate this information with the user's profile and use

              customer or an existing customer.<div class="olh_note"><div class="note__content"><div role="note" class="olh_note"><div class="note-container"><span class="svg-container"><svg                 <p class="p">Keys passed as <code class="ph codeph">Custom Parameters</code> are accessible as
                  ${consumerData.extra_params.&lt;your_key&gt;} in agent responses.</p>
              </div></div></div></div><div class="olh_note"><div class="note__content"><div role="note" class="olh_note"><div class="note-container"><span class="svg-container"><svg                 <p class="p">We don’t store this message and it’s only available for use in the next agent
                  response. Keys passed as <code class="ph codeph">Message Parameters</code> are accessible as
                  ${extra_params.&lt;your_key&gt;} in agent responses.</p>
              </div></div></div></div></li></ul></li><li class="li">
          <p class="p">Configure the following output variables in the Process Message method:</p>
          <ul class="ul"><li class="li">
              <p class="p"><span class="ph uicontrol">TextResponse</span>—The text output configured within the AI agent;
                works only if no other type of rich or special elements is present. Also, for
                multiple text items in the response, the first text item is returned.</p>
            </li><li class="li">
              <p class="p"><span class="ph uicontrol">FullResponse </span>—The full response with all rich elements and multiple messages present in the output from the agent.</p>
            </li><li class="li">
              <p class="p"><span class="ph uicontrol">Datastore</span> —A JSON/dict of all user-defined sessions variables within the agent </p>
            </li><li class="li">
              <p class="p"><span class="ph uicontrol">TransactionId</span> —The transaction id for the request in Webex AI Agent Studio</p>
            </li><li class="li">
              <p class="p"><span class="ph uicontrol">SessionId</span>—The session/conversation id in Webex AI Agent Studio
              </p>
            </li><li class="li">
              <p class="p"><span class="ph uicontrol">ConsumerId</span> —The customer id in Webex AI Agent Studio
              </p>
            </li><li class="li">
              <p class="p"><span class="ph uicontrol">MessageMetadata</span> —The metadata associated with the current response from the configured agent </p>
            </li><li class="li">
              <p class="p"><span class="ph uicontrol">SessionMetadata</span> —The metadata associated with the session
                for the current response from the configured agent </p><div class="olh_note"><div class="note__content"><div role="note" class="olh_note"><div class="note-container"><span             </li><li class="li">
              <p class="p"><span class="ph uicontrol">ResponsePayload</span> —The complete response payload from Webex AI Agent Studio</p>
            </li></ul>

                <p class="p">You can see the AI agents that you have access to in the Webex AI Agent Studio. For more information on managing users and agents in Webex AI Agent Studio, see  <a title="" href="https://help.webexconnect.io/docs/user-roles-and-hierarchy" data-scope="external">User roles and managing teammates</a>.</p>
              </div></div></div></div></li><li class="li"><span class="ph uicontrol">Session ID</span>—We close the AI agent session. Session ID is available as an output variable of the <span class="ph uicontrol">Process message</span> method. </li></ul></li></ol>
      <p class="p">For information on templates using AI agents on digital channels, see  <a title="" href="https://help.webexconnect.io/docs/using-ai-agent-flow-templates#ai-agent-livechat-generic" data-scope="external"> Using AI Agent flow templates</a>.</p>
    </section>
        <section class="section" id="section_qzc_bgb_1dc">
      <h2 class="title sectiontitle">Node Outcomes</h2>
      <p class="p">You can see the list of possible node outcomes for this node. You can customize the node
        labels using the <span class="ph uicontrol">Edit</span> (pencil) icon. The node exits through one of
        the node edges corresponding to the outcome of the node. Each AI Agent node corresponds to a
        node outcome. Here’s a list of node outcomes.</p><ul class="ul"><li class="li">Error (Red)—indicates the following: <ul class="ul"><li class="li">
                <p class="p"><span class="ph uicontrol">onError</span>—when the agent hasn’t responded with a message.
                </p>
              </li><li class="li">
                <p class="p"><span class="ph uicontrol">onInvalidCustomerID</span>—when a customer identifier is
                  missing.</p>
              </li><li class="li">
                <p class="p"><span class="ph uicontrol">onInvalidMessage</span> —when the message value is missing. </p>
              </li></ul></li><li class="li">Success (Green)—indicates the following:<ul class="ul"><li class="li">
                <p class="p"><span class="ph uicontrol">onSuccess</span>—when the agent responds with a message. </p>
              </li><li class="li">
                <p class="p"><span class="ph uicontrol">onAgentHandover</span>—when the agent raises a request to
                  handover to the agents. </p>
              </li></ul></li><li class="li">Timeout (Yellow/Amber)—indicates the following:<ul class="ul"><li class="li">
                <p class="p"><span class="ph uicontrol">onTimeOut</span>—when the agent hasn’t responded in not more than
                  15 seconds. </p>
              </li></ul></li></ul>
      <p></p>
    </section>
